title: Recipient disputes a recorded failed delivery attempt
snapshot: Tracking support reports a failed-attempt scan for DL-013 at 08:40 UTC on 2026-02-14, with the route record not yet reviewed. Yara Elt, the recipient, was at home but did not hear the intercom, and asks for a review and a new visit on the morning of 2026-02-15.
recorded_action: Iona emailed the Dispatch review team to review the failed-attempt record against the delivery stop, report the finding without inferring fault, and arrange a repeat attempt on the morning of 2026-02-15.

negatives.label: Handset and route sheet disagree

new_event.from: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
new_event.text: First check: the handset logs the 08:40 UTC attempt with reason 'Recipient absent'. The route sheet for the same stop records 'No access, gate locked'. The two reasons do not agree. No repeat attempt is booked yet.

negatives.expected_action: Keep both entries and ask the Dispatch review team by email for the handset location record and the driver's statement for the 08:40 attempt, with the 2026-02-15 morning attempt booked as a separate step.
negatives.must_not: Do not pick one reason and tell Yara that the gate was locked or that nobody was home; neither entry is a review finding.
negatives.done_means: The review team reports a finding supported by the location record, and the repeat attempt is confirmed separately; neither proves fault or a handover.

agent_event.to: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
agent_event.text: For DL-013 the handset gives 'Recipient absent' at 08:40 UTC and the route sheet gives 'No access, gate locked'. We are keeping both entries. Please send the handset location record and the driver's statement for that attempt, and report a finding from them. The 2026-02-15 morning repeat attempt is a separate request.

followup_event.from: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
followup_event.text: Review finding for DL-013: the handset location record places the 08:40 UTC attempt at the building's side gate, and the driver's statement says the gate was locked. The reason now reads 'No access'. The repeat attempt is not yet booked. This finding does not establish fault or a handover.

negatives.label: Review request email delivery delayed

new_event.text: Delivery delayed. Your message on DL-013 to Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics, has not been delivered. The server will keep retrying for 24 hours. No delivery confirmation has been received.

negatives.expected_action: Ask the Dispatch review team in Dispatch chat whether a review request for DL-013 is recorded, and send the request there once only if it is not.
negatives.must_not: Do not resend the email and post the same request in chat at once, which risks two reviews and two repeat bookings, and do not tell Yara the review has started.
negatives.done_means: The review team confirms one recorded request with a reference; this proves the review is registered, not its finding or the repeat attempt.

agent_event.to: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
agent_event.text: Our 09:25 UTC email asking you to review DL-013's failed-attempt record and arrange a 2026-02-15 morning repeat attempt shows as delayed. Is a review request for DL-013 recorded on your side? If not, we will post it here once. Please do not create a second request if the email arrives later.

followup_event.from: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
followup_event.text: Your request is recorded once: the 09:25 UTC email reached us at 09:44 UTC and is logged as review RV-013-02. No second request exists. This registers the review. It is not a finding and does not book the repeat attempt.

negatives.label: Requested morning no longer available

new_event.from: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
new_event.text: Review started. Morning capacity on 2026-02-15 for this route was filled at 09:35 UTC. Available repeat attempts: 2026-02-15, 13:00–17:00 UTC, or 2026-02-16, 09:00–12:00 UTC, both at no charge. Nothing is booked.

negatives.expected_action: Ask Yara in the Customer portal to choose between 2026-02-15, 13:00–17:00 UTC and 2026-02-16, 09:00–12:00 UTC, and pass only that choice to the review team.
negatives.must_not: Do not book the 2026-02-15 afternoon because the date matches; Yara offered the morning only.
negatives.done_means: Yara chooses one window and the review team confirms the booking; this is a repeat attempt booking, not a handover or a review finding.

agent_event.text: Morning capacity on 2026-02-15 is now full. The carrier can offer a repeat attempt on 2026-02-15, 13:00–17:00 UTC, or on 2026-02-16, 09:00–12:00 UTC, both at no charge. Nothing is booked yet. Which window should we ask them to book?

followup_event.from: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
followup_event.text: Yara's choice, relayed by you at 10:40 UTC, is booked: DL-013 repeat attempt on 2026-02-16, 09:00–12:00 UTC, at no charge. The review of the 08:40 attempt is still open. This is a repeat attempt booking, not a handover or a review finding.

negatives.label: Code change needs supervisor sign-off

new_event.from: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
new_event.text: We can book a repeat attempt, but changing or annotating a disputed failed-attempt code needs operations supervisor sign-off. We have not changed the record and will not issue a finding until a supervisor decides.

negatives.expected_action: Register DL-013 with the Operations supervisor queue by email, giving the 08:40 scan, Yara's statement, the source events, the exact question of whether the attempt code stands, and that the 2026-02-15 morning attempt is pending.
negatives.must_not: Do not ask the review team to change the exception code without sign-off, and do not tell Yara that the attempt record was wrong.
negatives.done_means: The supervisor queue accepts the case with a reference and a next-update time; nothing is decided, and the repeat attempt still needs its own confirmation.

agent_event.to: Operations supervisor queue, Plover Arc Logistics
agent_event.text: Please register DL-013 for a supervisor decision. Facts: failed-attempt scan at 08:40 UTC on 2026-02-14 (Tracking support, 09:00 UTC); Yara Elt states she was at home and did not hear the intercom (Customer portal, 09:10 UTC); the Dispatch review team needs sign-off to change or annotate the code (Email, 10:05 UTC). Question: does the attempt code stand? Pending: the 2026-02-15 morning repeat attempt.

followup_event.from: Operations supervisor queue, Plover Arc Logistics
followup_event.text: DL-013 is registered as SUP-013-1 at 10:50 UTC. A supervisor will review the attempt code and update you by 15:00 UTC today. Nothing is decided yet. The 2026-02-15 repeat attempt still needs its own booking confirmation from the Dispatch review team.

negatives.label: Tracker redelivery request runs in parallel

new_event.text: Yara Elt also used the public tracker at 09:15 UTC to request a redelivery for DL-013. That request is queued with Scheduling. Your review request to the Dispatch review team is a separate item.

negatives.expected_action: Ask the Dispatch review team by email to link the 09:15 tracker request to the review request and confirm that exactly one repeat attempt is booked for DL-013.
negatives.must_not: Do not let Scheduling and the review team each book an attempt, and do not cancel Yara's own request without linking it.
negatives.done_means: The review team confirms one booked attempt with the other request linked or closed; this does not prove the attempt will succeed or settle the review.

agent_event.to: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
agent_event.text: Yara Elt also requested a redelivery for DL-013 through the public tracker at 09:15 UTC, and it is queued with Scheduling. Please link that request to our 09:25 UTC review request and confirm that exactly one repeat attempt is booked. Please do not create a second booking.

followup_event.from: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
followup_event.text: Scheduling's 09:15 UTC tracker request is now linked to your review request and closed. One repeat attempt is booked for DL-013: 2026-02-15, 08:00–11:00 UTC, at no charge. The review of the 08:40 attempt is still open. This booking does not prove the attempt will succeed.
